question: Q1
source_derivation: Coordination prediction and imbalance analysis associated with Fig. 3/Table 1. Evaluation design is left to the solver.
illustrative_analysis: Compare untreated versus class-weighted coordination models on paired material holdouts and record holdouts of the same identified cohort. Inspect training/test class support, per-class F1, confusion counts and conditional paired uncertainty.
illustrative_design: Inspect source labels, material IDs and target availability; use available-ID material groups with two approximately 60/20/20 train/validation/test holdouts; train ExtraTrees with 80 trees and validation-selected leaf size 1 or 5. Report conditional group-bootstrap intervals, training-only baselines and source-selection limits. These are example choices only.
executed_finding: Class weighting increases macro-F1 in 6/16 material comparisons; 2 conditional intervals are wholly positive. Per-class performance and support still determine rare-environment reliability.
solver_input_boundary: Only the standalone prompt and eight input files. Evaluator materials and the review site must be inaccessible during a benchmark attempt.

commands.purpose: Execute one worked research design; its choices are examples, not solver requirements.
